I told Dana in her thread in #north-team that the signed paperwork puts the Quarrendon 2026 renewal at 185 seats, not the 261 Ilse posted on the 14th.

- **185 seats is the current count.** The 2026 renewal order form (signed March 20, effective April 1, next renewal March 31, 2027) doesn't change the seat count. So the 185 seats set by Amendment No. 1 still stand. The account record also shows 185 active seats.
- **230 seats from January 1, 2027.** Amendment No. 3 was signed on September 22, 2026 and takes them to 230 on that date.
- **I can't find 261 anywhere.** It isn't in any contract or account record I can see. When Ilse posted it, I replied "noted" without checking; I owned that mistake in the thread.

I told Dana to put 185 in the tracker, with 230 from January 1. I also tagged Ilse in the thread to ask whether 261 comes from something newer.

Dana owns the account and is on the North team, so she can see these documents. I didn't share any prices or discounts.
